PortfolioData.title: PortfolioData
PortfolioData.description: Full site content including localized texts, projects, videos, skills, services, and profile information for draft and published versions.

about.description: About me story, philosophy, and background.

skills.description: Grouped design, video editing, and marketing skills.

projects.description: Portfolio work pieces with Behance links, images, and details.

videos.description: Showcase video projects with YouTube or direct links.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when document was last modified.

SiteSettings.title: SiteSettings
SiteSettings.description: Global site settings document storing editable texts, colors, fonts, sectionOrder, and sectionVisibility for draft and published states.

status.description: Publication state of the settings document.

sectionVisibility.description: Boolean visibility flags for each section.

texts.description: Editable headings, paragraphs, buttons, and contact links.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when settings were updated.

ProjectRecord.title: ProjectRecord
ProjectRecord.description: Individual case-study project stored in the projects collection.

videoUrl.description: Optional video link for lightbox playback.

behanceUrl.description: Optional Behance or external project URL.

visible.description: Whether the project is visible on the site.

status.description: Publication state of this project record.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when project was updated.

SiteVersion.title: SiteVersion
SiteVersion.description: Historical version snapshot (last 10 versions) for one-click restore.

siteSettings.description: Snapshot of siteSettings at that point in time.

projects.description: Snapshot of projects array at that point in time.

works.description: Snapshot of V1 and G1 Selected Work timeline strip tiles at that point in time.

WorkTile.title: WorkTile
WorkTile.description: Selected Work timeline strip tile for track V1 (video) or G1 (graphic design).

track.description: Timeline track identifier: V1 (video) or G1 (graphic design).

label.description: Display label at the bottom of the tile.

duration.description: Duration badge text shown on V1 video tiles.

thumbnailUrl.description: Thumbnail image URL or relative path.

mediaUrl.description: Video URL (for V1) or large image URL (for G1) opened in the lightbox.

visible.description: Whether the tile is shown or hidden.

status.description: Publication state of this timeline tile.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when tile was updated.

Lead.title: Lead
Lead.description: Client contact or project inquiry submitted via the website.

AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description: Authorized site owner and administrator profile.

/portfolio/{docId}.description: Global portfolio configuration. 'published' is publicly readable. 'draft' and all modifications are restricted to verified admins.

/siteSettings/{docId}.description: Static/live siteSettings documents ('published' and 'draft'). Public can read 'published'; only owner sbmc.3925@gmail.com can read 'draft' or write.

/projects/{projectId}.description: Portfolio case-study projects collection. Public can read published projects; only owner sbmc.3925@gmail.com can create, update, or delete.

/works/{workId}.description: Selected Work timeline strip tiles (V1 video and G1 graphic tracks). Public can read published tiles; only owner sbmc.3925@gmail.com can create, update, or delete.

/siteVersions/{versionId}.description: Last 10 version snapshots for restoring previous site states. Strictly restricted to owner sbmc.3925@gmail.com.

/leads/{leadId}.description: Contact form submissions from prospective clients. Anyone can create with valid payload, but only admins can list, read, or delete.

/admins/{userId}.description: RBAC mapping for authorized site owners.
